Effect: FY2024 CFO original 194,097,339 -> restated 155,794,865; CFI (148,299,863) -> (109,997,389); total assets, equity, net income 248,749,238 unchanged; current FVTPL 116,272,717 -> 216,551,545, current amortised cost 100,716,421 -> 437,593. (2) FY2022: original CFO 379,760,632 / CFI (26,567,701) -> restated in the FY2023 filing 392,882,058 / (39,689,127) (rent and finance income reclassified; net change 112,483,287 unchanged); original non-current assets 1,805,723,032 -> 1,833,573,379. (3) FY2023 balance sheet liabilities re-split in the FY2024 filing (accrued expenses 243,851,178 -> contract liabilities 44,263,897 + accrued 199,587,281), totals unchanged. (4) FY2021 comparatives marked restated (Note 39). Interim income statements carry quarter and cumulative columns; cash flows cumulative only. Q1 2026 -> H1 2026: entity name changes to 'Holding' and a subsidiary is acquired (goodwill 36.5m, NCI 89.5m; Note 1), so 2026 is not like-for-like with 2025 consolidation scope. FY2025 income statement already includes 'investment income' and no discontinued operations are reported anywhere read.
